title: Petal proposals v1
description: A DAO's proposals and how each account voted on each (on hover, a proposal's yes and no votes show as dots inside the flower; an absent vote shows nothing). One per map, named by the map's address, read from the DAO's own chain and read again to refresh. An account that didn't vote on a proposal isn't in its votes: absent, never a guess. Each vote keeps the DAO's own word for it.

about.description: the map, by its address (its card's id)

source.description: where they were read: the DAO's kind, its contract, the calls, and when

kind.description: the DAO's kind, in a word: sputnik, baal

ref.description: the calls or events they were read from

title.description: its title, from its own text: a Title line, or its first words

kind.description: what it does, in the DAO's own word (Transfer, ChangePolicy, …), or null

closes_at.description: when its voting closes: by the DAO's policy (Sputnik's proposal period from submission), or as the DAO set it (Baal's vote end); null when unknown

decided_at.description: when it was decided, where the DAO records it (Baal's processing); null where it doesn't (Sputnik)

as_said.description: the DAO's own word for its status

votes.description: each account that voted, once; an account that didn't is absent

as_said.description: the DAO's own word for the vote: Approve, Reject, Remove, true, false

at.description: when it was cast, where the DAO records it (Baal's event), or null (Sputnik)
